code.github_vs_wheel: diff -rq of fm/ in the GitHub HEAD clone and in the 0.2.2 wheel: no differences (byte-identical package code)
code.dependency_notes: import fm executes fm/downstream/baseline.py, which imports ptflops; nothing imports scikit-learn. Install with --no-deps: numpy/pandas/tqdm come from the existing torch 2.10 environment, ptflops is pinned below. This prevents pip from replacing the working CUDA torch.

ptflops.role: import-time dependency of fm only; never called

weights.official_location_in_README: GitHub README (HEAD 3489515): 'Download pre-trained models from our Hugging Face repo https://huggingface.co/cuhkaih/rnafm/tree/main'
weights.verification: local sha256 equals the HF LFS oid and the x-linked-etag response header; size equals x-linked-size
weights.package_hub_url_status: fm.pretrained.rna_fm_t12() hub URL https://proj.cse.cuhk.edu.hk/rnafm/api/download?filename=RNA-FM_pretrained.pth returned HTTP 403 on 2026-10-15 (GET and HEAD), so the README-designated HuggingFace copy is used
weights.format: torch zip archive (fairseq checkpoint): keys args, cfg, model, criterion, optimizer_history, task_state, extra_state, last_optimizer_state
weights.safe_loading: torch.load(weights_only=True, mmap=True) with argparse.Namespace as the only allow-listed global; no arbitrary unpickling
weights.licence_note: HF repo card declares apache-2.0; GitHub code is MIT
